title: Tape Copying Machine
statement: Given a natural number $k$ and two work-tape indices $\mathrm{src},\mathrm{dst}\in\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$, define a machine over any symbol alphabet with sweep, rewind, and done states. In the sweep state, if the source head scans a symbol, the machine writes it at the destination head and moves both heads right; if the source scans blank, it moves both heads left and enters rewind. In rewind, it moves both heads left while the source scans a symbol, and when the source scans blank it moves both heads right and enters done. In done, it stays in that state without moving or writing.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{src}$ and $\mathrm{dst}$ are work-tape indices less than $k$
The machine uses an arbitrary symbol alphabet
